_why: #91: the audit gate had no execution path, so a repo test enforcing the audit loop's own invariant stayed red for 95 cycles while every cycle scored clean. Each row restores one way the suite result can be lost, softened, or read as a pass it never was — and the two that matter most are the ones where SILENCE becomes green.

mutations.name: an-unmeasured-suite-is-recorded-as-green
mutations._mechanism: THE defect, one level up: a cycle that never ran the suite contributes to the streak, so the exit gate closes on evidence nobody produced.

mutations.name: an-unmeasured-cycle-may-close-the-exit-gate
mutations._mechanism: Silence passes at the streak instead of at the stamp — the same hole reached from the other side.
mutations.find:
if suite is None:
                return {"verdict": "BLOCKED", "reason": f"suite_unmeasured:{path.name}"}

mutations.name: a-red-suite-no-longer-blocks-the-exit
mutations._mechanism: The decision reverts to advisory: the streak closes over a cycle whose suite was red, which is the 95-cycle case exactly.

mutations.name: the-suite-verdict-is-scored-on-the-exit-code
mutations._mechanism: rc has fooled this repo in both directions: a skipped selection and a killed run both exit 0, and a summary saying `2 failed` beside rc=0 then reads as a pass.
mutations.find: verdict = "PASS" if failed == 0 and passed > 0 else "FAIL"

mutations.name: a-collected-nothing-run-reads-as-a-pass
mutations._mechanism: A run that collected nothing exits 0 and is scored as a clean suite, so an empty selection closes the exit gate.

mutations.name: a-missing-summary-becomes-a-verdict
mutations._mechanism: A run that never reported is scored rather than refused, so a crash before collection reads as either green or red depending on nothing.

mutations.name: the-red-suite-hostages-the-cycle-verdict
mutations._mechanism: The rejected design: every audit cycle becomes hostage to an unrelated flaky test, and skill-candidates.md row 'concurrent-suite-runs-manufacture-phantom-failures' records the same tree giving 6, 3 and 0 failures across runs.

mutations.name: the-suite-result-is-woven-into-the-GATE-line
mutations._mechanism: `h_mad_audit_cycle.GATE_RE` anchors on `should=N\s*$`, so a fourth field there makes EVERY verdict un-parse — the reason GATE-CLASS is its own line too.

mutations.name: the-suite-runs-on-every-invocation
mutations._mechanism: Every existing caller suddenly runs a test suite it never asked for, which is minutes per gate call and a behaviour change nobody opted into. (Re-anchored 2026-09-07: the branch became `elif` when `--suite-result` was added for the cycle driver, which records a verdict measured once per cycle instead of running one per leg.)

mutations.name: gate-ignores-suite-timeout
mutations._mechanism: The flag parses and the gate still bounds the suite at the default: every long suite reads timeout_after_3600s again, the defect this flag exists to close.
mutations.find:
bound = DEFAULT_SUITE_TIMEOUT if args.suite_timeout is None else args.suite_timeout
        outcome = run_suite(args.project_tests, command, bound)

mutations.name: suite-timeout-accepts-zero
mutations._mechanism: A zero bound kills every suite at once and reads UNREADABLE forever; it must be a usage error, not a configuration.

mutations.name: suite-timeout-accepts-fractions
mutations._mechanism: `int(float(...))` silently truncates 1.5 to 1 and lets `inf` raise OverflowError as a traceback; whole seconds or a usage error.

mutations.name: gate-drops-the-orphan-refusal
mutations._mechanism: --suite-timeout without --project-tests is accepted and ignored: a flag silently dropped, so the caller believes a bound applied.
mutations.find: if args.suite_timeout is not None and args.project_tests is None:

mutations.name: the-default-bound-moves
mutations._mechanism: Every existing caller that passes no --suite-timeout changes behaviour; the default is pinned at 3600.

mutations.name: the-hold-notice-is-never-printed
mutations._mechanism: Row `orchestrator writes during the cycle suite read as tree_moved`: the suite runs in the live tree and nothing tells the orchestrator to hold its writes, so its own handoff commits and report writes read as tree_moved again.

mutations.name: the-hold-notice-is-not-flushed
mutations._mechanism: Printed but buffered: on a redirected stdout the notice lands after the suite has already run, so a reader waiting for it holds nothing while the suite measures.

mutations.name: the-hold-notice-names-the-test-dir
mutations._mechanism: The notice names the test dir instead of the git toplevel the digest covers, so the operator reads doc writes outside it (the row's actual offenders) as safe.

mutations.name: the-hold-notice-reads-as-a-suite-verdict
mutations._mechanism: A notice under the `SUITE:` token gives every `startswith("SUITE:")` reader two verdict lines, and the first one is not a verdict.
